findings.title: Saved searches stored a subdivision filter matching zero listings; alerts could never fire
findings.repro: Save a search on /homes-for-sale/bend/river-west, then inspect listing_alerts.filters -> {"subdivision":"river-west"}, which matches 0 rows while boundary_neighborhood=River West has 7,215.

findings.title: Valuation form hung on "Sending..." for 20-150s+; seller never saw confirmation
findings.repro: Submit /sell/valuation. Button stays "Sending..."; three real submits settled at 77s, 20s and never-within-150s while the lead was captured invisibly.

findings.title: /account sat on skeleton loaders ~24s (unindexed list_number, 62s query)
findings.repro: Sign in with 12 saved homes and open /account; EXPLAIN showed Parallel Seq Scan removing 593,866 rows in 62,033 ms.

findings.title: Advanced-search RPC could never match a multi-code property type
findings.repro: search_listings_advanced(p_property_type := 'A,B,C') returned 0 because the predicate was ILIKE; the app sends a CSV of MLS codes.

findings.title: Market-report prefs silently discard changes unless a separate Save button is clicked
findings.repro: On /account/notifications toggle "Market report emails" and pick areas, then reload: everything reverts and no crm_report_subscriptions row exists. Every other toggle on the page auto-saves, under a header reading "Changes save automatically."

findings.title: Autocomplete has no entry for "RiverWest" (one word)
findings.repro: Type RiverWest in site search -> "No results". The neighborhood is registered as "River West".

findings.title: Search pages degrade to 20-50s while the 15-minute post-sync pipeline runs
findings.repro: /homes-for-sale/redmond/multi-family measured 51.5s, 4.4s, 36.7s during run_post_sync_pipeline(cron-15min); the underlying MV query is 106ms.

findings.title: marketing_assignments accumulates a row per event, not per person
findings.repro: One test buyer produced 12 identical idx-registration buyer assignment rows plus 4 others (16 total).

findings.title: Listing-detail Save/Like controls have no accessible name
findings.repro: The detail-page control is a bare text "Save" button with no aria-label, unlike the card control.
